newsitem.title: ITALY: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Wednesday May 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Wednesday May 21.

text.p: Following are some of the top headlines in leading Italian newspapers.
* Cabinet secretary Enrico Micheli said the Italian government's forthcoming three-year programme of economic targets (Dpef) would be examined by the cabinet early next week (all).

* Centre-left government called a confidence vote in parliament on a decree law aimed at speeding up the approval process for starting construction programmes. The move, aimed at sweeping away some 400 amendments tabled by the separatist Northern League, is the government's 23rd confidence vote since prime minister Romano Prodi took office a year ago (all).
* Preliminary figures released by four sample cities showed Italian consumer price inflation rose 1.5 percent year-on-year in May, raising expectations of an official discount rate cut (all).

* Shares in Banco Ambrosiano Veneto fell 6.4 percent on the Milan Bourse after Italy's largest savings bank Cariplo agreed on Monday evening to open merger talks with Ambroveneto. The operation would reportedly require the banking group to make a substantial capital increase to fund the 6.5 trillion lire merger with Cariplo (all).
* Monte dei Paschi di Siena said its administrative body had nominated unanimously Luigi Spaventa, a former Budget minister, as the bank's new president (Sole 24 Ore).
Reuters has not verified these stories and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
